steps.title: Warm R10 Media
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm R10 medium in a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Thaw Cell Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen cell vials using a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Dilute and Spin Cells
steps.instruction: Add the thawed cells to 14 mL of pre‑warmed R10 medium, then centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add thawed cells to 14 mL R10.

steps.title: Resuspend Pellet and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 3 mL of R10 medium and determine cell concentration using a cell counter.

steps.title: Rest Cells with DNAse I
steps.instruction: Incubate cells for at least 3 hours (up to overnight) at a density of 2 × 10⁶ cells/mL in R10 medium supplemented with 1 µL/mL DNAse I, at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare Antibody Master Mix
steps.instruction: During the resting period, prepare the extracellular staining (ECS) antibody cocktail master mix and adjust the ECS volume so that each test uses 50 µL total with FACS buffer.

steps.title: Adjust PBS Volume and Transfer
steps.instruction: After resting, add PBS to bring the total volume up to either 15 mL or 50 mL (whichever is closer, rounding up) and transfer the suspension to a matching 15 mL or 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Spin and Resuspend to Desired Concentration
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature (RT), discard supernatant, then resuspend cells in PBS to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL and recount. If the suspension is too dilute, repeat the spin and resuspend to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 500 × g for 5 min RT.
Count cells; if dilute, re‑spin and resuspend to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL.

steps.title: Plate Cells in 96‑Well Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 mL of the cell suspension (containing 2 × 10⁶ cells) into each well of a V‑bottom 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Spin Plate Before Staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well plate at 500 × g for 5 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Add PBS Wash
steps.instruction: Add 45 µL of PBS to each well using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Add Viability Dye
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 1 : 60 Aqua viability dye directly to each cell pellet and resuspend the cells.

steps.title: Incubate Viability Dye
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 10 minutes at RT in the dark.

steps.title: Add Antibody Cocktail and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the ECS antibody cocktail to each well and incubate for 20 minutes at RT in the dark; prepare 1 % PFA fixation buffer while the incubation proceeds.

steps.title: Add FACS Buffer and Spin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of FACS buffer to each well, then centrifuge the plate at 500 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Fix Cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and fix the cells by adding 200 µL of 1 % PFA to each well.

steps.title: Acquire Data on Flow Cytometer
steps.instruction: Run the fixed samples on a flow cytometer according to the instrument’s standard acquisition settings.
